## What is this about?

Check vehicles distributed by share of American components, from 0% to 100%, across filters: vehicle type, manufacturing corporation, and region of those corporations. Currently for selected model years only.
For best experience, open with your personal computer or laptop.

## Try it yourself

  See the source code now on [GitHub](https://github.com/Witold1/cars-made-in-usa).

## Inspiration

* [Better Data Visualization Using Beeswarm Chart by Martin Heinz](https://martinheinz.dev/blog/27)
* [James Trimble, Dataviz at Office for National Statistics (UK) notebooks on Beeswarm, Jitter, and Histogram plots](https://observablehq.com/@jtrim-ons?page=2)
* [Ken Flerage's article on beeswarms in Tableau](https://www.flerlagetwins.com/2020/11/beeswarm.html)
